text:
mike: heads-up — scheduling Wave-17 tomorrow 06:00 UTC (22:00 PT). Plan is a phased regional cascade: EU -> NA -> APAC. There is a short metadata DB migration that needs a read-only pause (~3m). Deploy window 06:00-07:00 UTC. Need owners for each step and confirmation on rollback readiness.
jen: I can own EU->NA handoff and smoke for api-gw. Will run the smoke checklist and report.
sahil: I'll take APAC + DB migration execution. Who's owning rollback?
lara: I can own rollback script and telemetry HPA adjustments. I have a tested rollback script (dry-run).
mike: Deploy order (high level): 1) api-gw 2) inference-svc 3) telemetry 4) batch-workers. Canary at 10% after each service for ~5m. Abort condition: errors >5% or latency >300ms p95. Use deploy-bot to orchestrate cascade and migration pause.
deploy-bot: To start cascade: `/deploy start --wave wave-17 --mode cascade --pause-migration --canary 10% --smoke checks/wave-17.json`
jen: Smoke checklist (short):
- GET /health -> 200
- 10 sample requests against api-gw -> expected responses
- logs: no ERROR spike in last 2m
- latency p50 <200ms, p95 <350ms
sahil: DB migration details:
- set metadata-db read_only=true for ~3m
- `ALTER TABLE metadata ADD COLUMN indexed_flag boolean DEFAULT false`
- short backfill kicked as separate async job after wave finishes
Need db-admin to toggle read_only on/off.
mike: @lara confirm rollback script will revert column add and redeploy previous tags if we abort? Also we should set telemetry autoscale min replicas=2 for 30m post-deploy to absorb spikes.
lara: rollback script path: `infra/scripts/rollback-wave-17.sh` — reverts migration (drops column if created) and deploys previous images. Dry-run passed. I'll also set HPA override during the window. Need @alex to be on standby for DB toggle.
alex: I can be on standby during the window for read_only toggle and watch replication lag.
jen: ops ask: can we shorten migration pause to 90s if the alter is quick? Less user-visible read-only time is preferred.
sahil: We can attempt to shorten to 90s, but will keep 3m as planned and abort early if migration completes. Backfill remains separate.
mike: Quick runbook / abort snippet for visibility:
- `/deploy abort --wave wave-17`
- run `infra/scripts/rollback-wave-17.sh`
- set metadata-db read_only=false (alex)
- notify #oncall and #product
lara: I'll add the HPA override step: set telemetry.minReplicas=2 for 30m post-deploy.
jen: :thumbsup: confirmed on my side. I'll attach smoke logs to the runbook.
sahil: confirmed. I'll post the exact migration SQL in the runbook now.
alex: confirmed and will monitor DB.
mike: Owners recap: EU/NA + api-gw smoke: jen; APAC + DB migration: sahil; rollback + telemetry HPA: lara; DB toggle & replication watch: alex. If anyone has blockers call them out now.
jen: no blockers.
sahil: no blockers.
lara: no blockers.
alex: no blockers.
mike: thanks all — I'm scheduling the deploy job and will post the Runbook link in ~15m: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/wave-17. Will also pin the smoke checklist and deploy-bot command. :rocket:
